fields.resolution: ENDEX. It is now 20:00. The shutdown of Pressure District 7 has been confirmed. RCV-01 and RCV-04 are closed. Valve 11 and Valve 12 are confirmed closed on site. Field gauges now read 0 in. w.c. at RS-21 and RS-22. PR-7B is offline, but pressure is stable. No further incidents have been reported. The EOC remains activated. The forensic team has completed evidence collection from CVG-OT-JMP01 and the RTUs. CISA has been notified and is reviewing the memory image. The IC has authorized the start of the phased return to control under C8. The hot wash will now begin.
finalState: Pressure District 7 is fully isolated; RCV-01 and RCV-04 closed.
Valve 11 and Valve 12 confirmed closed by field crews.
Field gauges at RS-21 and RS-22 read 0 in. w.c.
SCADA remote control re-enabled for RS-21 and RS-22; no discrepancies.
The halden-support account has been permanently revoked by TSA.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Put down your phones and radios. We will take ten minutes, then start the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things that broke
hotWashQuestions: How did the team reconcile trust in SCADA data versus field evidence?
What was the impact of delayed verification on public trust and media response?
How did the manual override process align with CVG-CIRP-2026 and EOP 6.4?
What were the key challenges in maintaining command authority during conflicting data streams?
How could future drills better prepare for cyber-physical overpressure incidents with delayed detection?
fields.facilitatorNote: Collect all ICS 201 forms and evaluator sheets before the break. Confirm CISA and TSA have received the final forensic package.
